spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (उञ्झति)
To quit or abandon. This is some. times read उद्झ्.
With प्र,
to escape or avoid.

m. (-ञ्झः)
Abandoning, leaving.
E.
उञ्झ and क aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Left, abandoned.
2 Left off, discontinued.
E.
उञ्झ to leave, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what leaves.
E.
उञ्झ and तृच् aff.
